paragraphs: The GLC200 has been part of the GLC-Class range since the model launched in 2015, spanning two generations under one badge. The X253 generation (2015–2022) uses the M274 — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine shared across a wide range of Mercedes models of that era. From 2022, the X254-generation GLC200 switched to the M254, a newer 2.0-litre four-cylinder unit with mild-hybrid technology that delivers the same 255hp but with more torque (295 lb-ft vs the earlier 258 lb-ft). Knowing which one your car has matters, because the components and rebuild specifics differ between them — which is exactly why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every GLC200 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol fitted to the GLC200 from 2015 to 2022. No widely-reported specific issue has been independently confirmed for this engine in the GLC200 application, but we replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every rebuild.

The current 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol with mild-hybrid technology, fitted from 2022. This is a different unit from the M274, with its own design features including an integrated starter-generator. No widely-reported specific issue has been independently confirmed for this engine in the GLC200 application, but we service it to the same high standard as our other GLC-Class rebuilds.

compatibility.intro: Because the GLC200 spans two distinct engines across two generations, fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming an M274 part will work on an M254 car — risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (M256) via registration or VIN
Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic GLC-Class quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
